action: Explain the service and region cost increase

assumptions: Cost is grouped by service and region for the assessment period.
The baseline is the declared comparison period, not a forecast or a budget.
calculation.formula: increase_usd = cost_usd - baseline_usd; ratio = cost_usd / baseline_usd; fires when ratio >= min_ratio_to_baseline and increase_usd >= min_increase_usd

estimated_impact.basis: Not estimated: the increase is observed evidence; the avoidable share is unknown until the workload is reviewed.

recommendation: Inspect workload changes, tags, and query patterns for this service and region before changing reservations or commitments.

action: Review query plan and filters of the largest job

assumptions: bytes_billed is the billed volume reported by job metadata; it is used as a volume signal, not a price.
calculation.formula: terabytes_billed = bytes_billed / 10^12; fires when bytes_billed >= threshold_bytes

estimated_impact.basis: Not estimated: the assessment supplies no BigQuery pricing model, edition, or location.

recommendation: Review the query plan, selected columns, and filters for this job before changing the workload.

title: Job billed an excessive number of bytes

action: Add a partition filter and confirm pruning

assumptions: The reduction from pruning depends on filter selectivity, which job metadata does not reveal.
calculation.formula: fires when references_partitioned_table and not partition_pruned and bytes_billed >= min_bytes_billed

estimated_impact.basis: Not estimated: the share of partitions a filter would skip is unknown.

recommendation: Add or correct a filter on the partitioning column and confirm pruning in the query plan.

action: Evaluate materializing or caching the repeated query

assumptions: The fingerprint groups jobs with the same normalized query; query text is not collected.
The estimate is an upper bound that holds only if one run's result could serve the other runs.

estimated_impact.basis: Volume billed by every run after the first; it is not a monetary saving.
estimated_impact.unit: TB (10^12 bytes) in the assessment period (upper bound)

recommendation: Check whether results can be materialized, cached, or shared across runs before changing the schedule.
subject: fp-adhoc-cohort
title: Expensive query pattern runs repeatedly

action: Align schedule frequency with source refreshes

assumptions: Runs and source updates are counted from job metadata over the assessment window.
A run that starts before the source changes again returns the same result as the previous run.

estimated_impact.basis: Volume billed by runs that start between source updates; it is not a monetary saving.

recommendation: Align the schedule with source refreshes or trigger it on source updates, after confirming freshness requirements.
subject: fp-hourly-kpi-refresh
title: Scheduled query runs more often than its source changes

action: Review reservation baseline against peak usage

assumptions: Average slot usage comes from reservation timeline metadata for the observed hours.
Peak usage is shown because a lower baseline can delay queries during peaks.
calculation.formula: utilization = avg_slots_used / baseline_slots; idle_slot_hours = (baseline_slots - avg_slots_used) * hours_observed

estimated_impact.basis: Observed capacity minus observed average use; no price is applied.
estimated_impact.unit: slot-hours of idle baseline capacity in the observed window

recommendation: Review baseline and autoscaling settings with the workload owner against peak usage; this is an observation, not a capacity change.
subject: res-batch-etl
title: Reservation baseline slots are mostly idle

action: Confirm owner and dependencies before resizing

assumptions: Utilization comes from approved metric telemetry averaged over observed_days.
Cost is assumed to scale linearly with provisioned capacity; minimum sizes and dependencies can make the real reduction smaller.

estimated_impact.basis: Cost share attributed to unused capacity under the linear-cost assumption; it is not a confirmed saving.

recommendation: Confirm dependencies and service-level requirements with the owner before resizing, pausing, or retiring the resource.
subject: redshift-reporting
title: Data-platform resource is underutilized

action: Collect missing evidence before any commitment

assumptions: Past monthly usage does not guarantee future usage.
A purchase is only considered when history, discount rate, and forecast confirmation are all supplied.

missing_evidence: a usage forecast confirmed by the workload owner

estimated_impact.basis: Not estimated: 12 months of usage history, an approved discount rate, a usage forecast confirmed by the workload owner not supplied.

recommendation: No purchase recommendation: evidence is incomplete (missing 12 months of usage history, an approved discount rate, a usage forecast confirmed by the workload owner).
subject: AWS Glue
title: Steady on-demand usage with low commitment coverage
